Age fit: The words stay short and the only control is one Push button. Ages 9 to 13 can read the mass and the speed-up sentence.
Whether it teaches the objective: A push applies one force. The readout predicts that a heavier mass speeds up less, and the box moves that way.
Interaction quality: The push is the teaching gesture. The box and the prediction both respond to that press.
Mobile feel: The button sits at the top, with a tall tap target, and the track fills the rest of the frame.
Tutor-guide completeness: The guide records observation prompts and a misconception about heavier boxes traveling farther. Scientific accuracy is left for staff.
